name: Compound Name
abstract: A multiple part name, consisting of a set of strings with functional roles that can be combined into single string using a template.

examples.title: Example CompoundName
examples.content: A name with a label, but also a set of parts with roles that can be validated against content rules.

examples.title: Referenced Parts
examples.content: An example name where part of the name is a reference to a vocabulary source.  This can us used for validation and multi-linual applications

annotatedSchema:
$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
description: Compound Name
properties:
  label:
    anyOf:
    - type: 'null'
    - type: string
    x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label
  template:
    type: string
  hasPart:
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      properties:
        label:
          type: string
          x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label
        ref:
          $ref: https://opengeospatial.github.io/bblocks/annotated-schemas/ogc-utils/iri-or-curie/schema.yaml
          x-jsonld-type: '@id'
          x-jsonld-id: https://linked.data.gov.au/def/csdm/commonpatterns/namePartRef
        type:
          type: string
          x-jsonld-type: '@id'
          x-jsonld-base: https://linked.data.gov.au/def/csdm/names/localPartType/
          x-jsonld-id: https://linked.data.gov.au/def/csdm/commonpatterns/namePartType
      anyOf:
      - required:
        - label
      - required:
        - ref
    x-jsonld-id: http://purl.org/dc/terms/hasPart
x-jsonld-extra-terms:
  name: https://linked.data.gov.au/def/csdm/commonpatterns/name
  CompoundName: https://linked.data.gov.au/def/csdm/commonpatterns/CompoundName
x-jsonld-prefixes:
  dct: http://purl.org/dc/terms/
  commonpatterns: https://linked.data.gov.au/def/csdm/commonpatterns/
  rdfs: http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#
  csdm: https://linked.data.gov.au/def/csdm/
